rule: lesson = {trigger, cause, repair, evidence, scope}; persisted only when verified and reusable; reviewer decides

lessons.trigger: jomission/qualification/intrinsic.py (V2.1c design numerics) written without loading the biophysical-modeling skill
lessons.cause: no startup step routes modelling work to domain skills; skill loading depended on the agent noticing
lessons.repair: jomission-gate-runner fronts every execution; its step 1 now names domain skills to load (added from this lesson)
lessons.scientific_consequence: none implied by this fact alone (reviewer 2026-09-16); V2.1c numerics stand on their own tests

lessons.trigger: tier-0 failed after a legitimate TODO status change (SCI-V21C-BOUNDARY OPEN_AFTER_HARNESS -> OPEN)
lessons.repair: test now asserts durable invariants only (items exist in a live status; LOCKED gates stay LOCKED); statuses validated against evidence by validate_current_state
lessons.scope: project tests: never encode current state in a test
lessons.recurrence: 2026-09-16 V2.1c-boundary seal: test_verdict_status_follows_evidence_not_tests read the live V2.1c review_override; repaired to build overrides on copies of the sealed V2.1b entry. Remaining tier-0 tests read only sealed evidence or copies.

lessons.trigger: owner retired the V2 chain 2026-09-19 and tier-0 failed on test_preserved_science_todo asserting V2.2-RECURRENCE and BLIND-OMISSION are LOCKED
lessons.cause: the test still encoded a current status despite its own durable-invariants comment; the L2 repair did not cover the chain assertion
lessons.repair: the chain assertion now accepts the durable set {LOCKED, RETIRED}; a retired chain can never become executable without a new authorization
lessons.scope: project tests: status assertions must name the full terminal set, not the current value

lessons.trigger: WinError 32 on TemporaryDirectory cleanup in the t4_t5 and t7 artifact tests
lessons.cause: the tests' own np.load of an npz keeps the zip handle open on win32; no mmap exists in the analysis modules
lessons.repair: close the NpzFile before the temp context exits; test-harness only, no quarantine
lessons.evidence: commit 9aa6283; serial reruns 31.39s and 26.70s with no PermissionError
lessons.scope: windows test hygiene: every npz load in a temp dir

lessons.trigger: five Q8 tests failed with TypeError: DynamicState.__new__() missing theta_S, aux, b after the 0.4.24 migration
lessons.cause: state_replacement.py constructed the state from a hardcoded six-field list that predates the engine's NamedTuple
lessons.repair: rebuild through the namedtuple's own _replace (undeclared fields preserved by construction) and derive hash/shape/verify field lists from DynamicState._fields
lessons.scope: any code that builds engine state: replace, never reconstruct

lessons.trigger: tier-2 foreground run aborted twice by the owner; the detached relaunch was killed by the harness (ChildProcess.kill on the spawning shell)
lessons.cause: this environment has no background execution: long foreground runs get aborted and detached processes are reaped
lessons.repair: run long batteries only in the foreground with the owner present, or split them; do not relaunch detached
lessons.evidence: 2026-09-19 session: two owner aborts, one harness kill, zero output
lessons.scope: this environment: scheduling of minute-plus runs

lessons.trigger: editing jomission/*.py produced whole-file normalization (trailing-space strip plus line rewrap) on top of the intended change, three times: t4_t5_analysis.py 293+/93-, builder.py 181+/49-, hdp_attractor.py 1045+/554-
lessons.cause: unverified: suspected edit-time formatter (global opencode formatter:true is set); tests/*.py edits did not balloon, so the trigger condition is unknown
lessons.repair: treat large .py diffs as suspect: confirm the semantic hunks are only the intended ones, then rely on the covering tests as the behavior arbiter; never assume a small edit means a small diff
lessons.evidence: commits 78ab111, b9a6443, f8e1809 diff stats vs intended-change sizes
